title: Quantity Surveyor
description:
**Company Description**
EK Homes is a real estate company focused on creating innovative, high-quality living spaces that enrich communities and improve residents’ everyday lives. The organization is committed to delivering lasting value through well-planned developments and meticulous attention to detail. EK Homes strives to build trust by consistently meeting expectations for design, quality, and functionality. The company values excellence, reliability, and long-term relationships with buyers, partners, and stakeholders.
  
**Role Description**
The Quantity Surveyor at EK Homes will manage and monitor project costs across all phases of residential and commercial developments. Day-to-day responsibilities include preparing and reviewing Bills of Quantities (BOQ), supporting cost planning and budgeting, tracking variations, and ensuring cost control in line with project objectives. The role involves coordinating with project managers, site engineers, contractors, and vendors to verify quantities, validate invoices, and prepare cost reports for management. The Quantity Surveyor will also contribute to tender documentation, assist in contract administration, and support value engineering initiatives. This is a full-time, on-site role based in Chennai.
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong cost control and cost management skills to ensure projects remain within approved budgets.
* Candidates should possess BOQ preparation and quantity take-off skills to support accurate estimates and tender documentation.
* Candidates should possess cost planning and budgeting skills to develop forecasts and financial plans for projects.
* Candidates should possess cost reporting and variance analysis skills to provide clear, timely updates to stakeholders.
* Candidates should ideally have a bachelor’s degree in Quantity Surveying, Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field.
* Candidates should possess proficiency in MS Excel and quantity surveying software, along with strong analytical and numerical abilities.
* Candidates should possess effective communication and negotiation skills, and the ability to collaborate with multidisciplinary project teams.
* Experience in residential or commercial real estate projects and knowledge of local construction standards and regulations in Chennai are beneficial.

title: QRM-New Client Acceptance (NCA) Specialist – Senior Analyst
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**CMAT**
CMAT, a key Strategic Enabler in our new model, is comprised of professionals with various areas of focus that collectively provide mission critical services to support Deloitte’s overall success. Whether focused on project financials, quality and risk management, methods and tools, sales excellence, talent, leadership support, or other activities these professionals ensure that our Firm operates efficiently, and our people are able to effectively serve clients every day.
  
  
Level: Consultant
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As an NCA Specialist, you will:
  
  

* Leverage Deloitte’s internal applications and external research tools to perform due diligence and research activities
* Help the team identify potential risks associated with new and returning clients to the Consulting practice
* Provide recommendations on the acceptance of clients for evaluation by industry and risk leaders
* Respond to inquiries, requests, and concerns in a timely manner and coordinate appropriate follow-up and escalations
* Capture, evaluate, and document processes related to issues for resolution
* Actively collaborate with members of the risk team to aid in the evolution of the team's growth and of our path

**The team**
The New Client Acceptance (NCA) Specialist will be a member of the Consulting – National – Quality and Risk Management (QRM) team. The mission of QRM is to manage the risk in our growing and increasingly complex business to improve financial performance and protect the firm’s assets and reputation.
  
  
This individual will be responsible for managing the entire lifecycle of the NCA process for prospective and existing Consulting clients. As an integral member of the team, the NCA specialist will work closely with the existing NCA team, the automation team, the QRM team, and other stakeholders.
  
  
Location: Hyderabad/ Bengaluru/ Pune/ Chennai
  
  
Shift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PM

Required:
  
  

* Education: BBA/BA/BS in related field
* Experience: 3-5 years of relevant experience

* Ability to manage own schedule, evaluate priorities, effectively plan and organize, and be attentive to deadlines
* Excels in both independent work and collaborative team environments
* Expert-level proficiency with Microsoft Word and Excel
* Excellent English verbal communication and written skills
* Commitment to learning multiple packages / applications
* Demonstrated problem-solving skills

Preferred:
  
  

* Good knowledge of PowerPoint and familiarity with Tableau reporting
* Experience in secondary research

**Our purpose**

It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. title: Senior Finance Manager – Global Finance (CA / CPA)
description:
Senior Finance Manager – Global Finance (CA / CPA)

Location Hyderabad, Telangana, India

Employment Type Full-time

Shift Night shift (aligned to US / Canada time zones)

Experience 8+ years in finance and accounting Qualification Chartered Accountant (CA) or Certified Public Accountant (CPA) Function Finance & Accounting

About the Role We are looking for a qualified finance professional (CA or CPA) with 8+ years of experience, including exposure to global finance operations for North American entities. In this full-time, Hyderabadbased role, you will work the night shift to partner directly with US and Canada stakeholders on financial reporting, close, planning and compliance. You will own the quality and timeliness of financial outputs, strengthen controls and drive process improvements, while guiding and developing a team of finance professionals. Key Responsibilities

• Lead the month-end, quarter-end and year-end close, ensuring accurate and timely financial statements.

• Prepare and review financial reporting and consolidations in line with US GAAP and/or IFRS, with applicable Canadian reporting requirements.

• Own general ledger accounting, account reconciliations, accruals, intercompany and balance sheet review.

• Support budgeting, forecasting and variance analysis, providing clear commentary and insights to business and finance leadership.

• Coordinate with internal and external auditors, and support statutory, tax and regulatory filings for US and Canadian entities.

• Support indirect and direct tax requirements, including US sales tax and Canadian GST/HST, in coordination with tax advisors.

• Maintain and strengthen internal controls and documentation, supporting SOX or equivalent compliance frameworks.

• Partner with North American finance, operations and business teams across time zones to resolve queries and meet reporting deadlines.

• Drive process improvement, standardization and automation across finance workflows.

• Lead, mentor and review the work of finance team members, setting clear priorities and quality standards.

Required Qualifications & Experience

• Chartered Accountant (CA) or Certified Public Accountant (CPA) qualification.

• 8+ years of relevant experience in accounting, financial reporting, controllership or finance operations.

• Hands-on experience supporting global finance operations, preferably for Canadian or US entities.

• Strong working knowledge of US GAAP and/or IFRS.

• Experience with ERP and financial systems (such as SAP, Oracle, NetSuite or similar) and advanced Excel skills.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills for working with international stakeholders.

• Willingness and ability to work night shifts from the Hyderabad office.

Good to Have

• Direct exposure to Canadian accounting and tax requirements (ASPE / IFRS, GST/HST) or US tax and compliance.

• Experience working in a shared services, GCC or outsourced finance environment serving North American clients.

• Experience with SOX or internal audit frameworks.

• Familiarity with BI and reporting tools (Power BI, Tableau) or finance automation tools.

• Prior experience leading or mentoring teams of finance professionals. Key Competencies

• Strong analytical and problem-solving ability with high attention to detail.

• Ownership, accountability and the ability to meet tight close deadlines.

• Stakeholder management and collaboration across geographies.

• Leadership, coaching and a continuous improvement mindset.

title: Manager - Incentive Compensation Design
description:
**Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients**
At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.
  
  
Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas – Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.
  
  
Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lie within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role the Manager, Field Effectiveness plays a critical hands-on role in supporting the effectiveness of the sales force through high-quality data analysis, reporting, and operational execution. This role sits at the intersection of data analytics, commercial operations, and field strategy, with a focus on enabling actionable insights and operational excellence.
  
  
This position reports to the Sr Manager, Field Effectiveness and will be responsible for the following
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Incentive Plan Design and Modeling**

* Design, develop, and implement field incentive compensation (IC) plans that align with brand strategies and sales goals.
* Build financial models to simulate plan performance under various scenarios using real and projected data.
* Conduct historical analysis and “what-if” simulations to evaluate plan effectiveness, fairness, and alignment.
* Prepare IC plan documents, FAQs, and communication decks to support field understanding and adoption.

**Contest Design**

* Create and manage short-term incentive contests (SPIFs) and tactical bonus programs to support product launches or boost performance.
* Analyze data to define contest eligibility, metrics, goals, and payout curves.
* Develop rules documents and communication materials for field engagement.
* Track contest performance and manage end-to-end execution from concept through payout.

**Health Check Analytics and Plan Monitoring**

* Develop and run regular health checks to monitor plan effectiveness, payout distribution, and motivational integrity.
* Identify anomalies, outliers, or gaming behaviors and recommend corrective actions.
* Provide monthly/quarterly dashboards and insights to Sales Leadership on IC plan performance.
* Monitor alignment between incentive outcomes and commercial KPIs such as sales performance and call activity.

**Data Management and Processing**

* Extract, transform, and validate large datasets (e.g., sales, territory alignments, performance metrics).
* Perform data quality checks to ensure accuracy and completeness.

**Compliance, Governance, and Documentation**

* Maintain documentation of IC plan rules, calculations, exceptions, and approvals for audit readiness.

In this full-time, Hyderabad-based night-shift role, you will lead the team and ensure accurate lease and financial records, record tenant receipts and banking activity in Yardi, support monthly QuickBooks entries and reconciliations, coordinate property taxes and insurance, and manage leasing documentation and critical renewal dates. The ideal candidate brings 8+ years of experience in commercial lease administration, lease abstraction, tenant billing, financial reconciliations and property accounting, including experience leading or mentoring a team, with strong working knowledge of Yardi and QuickBooks. Key Responsibilities Team Leadership & Process Ownership

• Lead, mentor and review the work of lease administrators and analysts, setting priorities, deadlines and quality standards.

• Own lease administration, CAM, billing and accounting processes end to end, driving standardization, controls and continuous improvement.

• Act as the escalation point for complex lease interpretation, reconciliation variances and data discrepancies.

• Report KPIs, risks and resolution timelines to property management, finance and asset management leadership. Lease Abstraction & Administration

• Oversee the review and abstraction of commercial lease agreements, amendments, renewals and related documents.

• Capture key lease data, including terms, commencement and expiration dates, rent schedules, escalation clauses, options and tenant obligations.

• Maintain accurate and complete lease records in Yardi and track critical dates, expirations, renewals and rent escalations.

• Organize lease documentation and support lease audits and compliance reviews. CAM Setup & Reconciliation

• Set up and maintain CAM charges, recoveries and allocation parameters based on lease provisions.

• Review lease clauses to determine tenant responsibility for CAM, operating expenses, taxes, insurance and other recoverable costs.

• Own annual CAM reconciliations by comparing actual operating expenses with tenant billings and estimated payments, investigating variances and preparing supporting schedules. Sales Entry & Reporting

• Collect, review and enter tenant sales data, validating completeness, accuracy and compliance with lease reporting requirements.

• Follow up on missing, delayed or inconsistent tenant sales reports.

• Support percentage-rent calculations and generate sales reports with accurate historical records. Accounts Receivable & Tenant Billing

• Reconcile weekly bank report receipts and record deposits and non-sufficient funds (NSF) transactions in Yardi.

• Prepare the pre-authorized payment (PAP) sheet.

• Download tenant invoices and send them to the respective tenants. Property Accounting & Expense Coordination

• Enter monthly income, expenses and GST in QuickBooks and reconcile accounts.

• Manage property assessments and property taxes, including related records and coordination.

• Manage property insurance administration and documentation.

• Send monthly shareholder expense information to the accounting team. Yardi Reporting, Reconciliations & Quality Control

• Reconcile information across executed leases, Yardi records and QuickBooks, and investigate and document discrepancies.

• Prepare reports and dashboards covering lease status, expirations, rent schedules, CAM reconciliations and sales reporting.

• Assist with data validation, variance analysis, budgeting, forecasting and cash flow analysis.

• Maintain audit-ready records, follow internal controls and report outstanding issues and risks to stakeholders. Leasing Documentation & Ad Hoc Support

• Maintain move-out reports and organize leasing folders and supporting records.

• Prepare lease documentation for projects and prioritize urgent lease-renewal dates with timely follow-up.

• Coordinate with property management, finance, accounting, leasing and asset management teams.

Required Qualifications & Experience

• Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, Business Administration, Real Estate or a related field.

• 8+ years of experience in lease administration, commercial real estate operations, property accounting or lease management, including team leadership or mentoring experience.

• Working knowledge of commercial lease structures, rent schedules, CAM recoveries and lease clauses.

• Experience in lease abstraction, financial reconciliations and operational reporting.

• Working knowledge of Yardi (receipts, deposits, tenant invoicing, PAP schedules, NSF recording) and QuickBooks (income, expense and GST entries, account reconciliations).

• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including lookups, pivot tables, data validation and reconciliation worksheets.

• Strong attention to detail, analytical skills, documentation practices and time management.

• Willingness to work night shifts from the Hyderabad office.

Good to Have

• Experience with commercial office, retail or mixed-use property portfolios.

• Knowledge of percentage rent, tenant sales reporting, operating expense recoveries and lease escalations.

• Exposure to property management and accounting platforms beyond Yardi and QuickBooks. • Ability to manage high volumes of lease data while maintaining accuracy.

• Strong communication, stakeholder management, people leadership and processimprovement skills. Key Performance Indicators

• Accuracy and completeness of lease abstraction and system data.

• Timely CAM setup and annual reconciliation completion. • Accuracy and timeliness of tenant sales entry and reporting.

• Timely weekly bank-report reconciliations and accurate recording of deposits and NSFs, PAP sheets and invoice distribution.

• Accuracy and timeliness of monthly QuickBooks income, expense and GST entries.

• Resolution time for data discrepancies and reconciliation variances.

• Timely tracking of lease expirations, renewals and other critical dates.

• Compliance with internal controls, documentation standards and reporting deadlines.

• Team performance, quality of work reviewed and timely delivery against agreed priorities.

The People-Service-Profit philosophy (P-S-P) describes the principles that govern every FedEx decision, policy, or activity. FedEx takes care of our people; they, in turn, deliver the impeccable service demanded by our customers, who reward us with the profitability necessary to secure our future. The essential element in making the People-Service-Profit philosophy such a positive force for the company is where we close the circle, and return these profits back into the business, and invest back in our people. Our success in the industry is attributed to our people. Through our P-S-P philosophy, we have a work environment that encourages team members to be innovative in delivering the highest possible quality of service to our customers. We care for their well-being, and value their contributions to the company.
  
  
Our Culture
  
  
Our culture is important for many reasons, and we intentionally bring it to life through our behaviors, actions, and activities in every part of the world. The FedEx culture and values have been a cornerstone of our success and growth since we began in the early 1970’s. While other companies can copy our systems, infrastructure, and processes, our culture makes us unique and is often a differentiating factor as we compete and grow in today’s global marketplace.

title: Reporting Analyst II
description:
**About Invesco**
As one of the world’s leading independent global investment firms, Invesco is dedicated to rethinking possibilities for our clients. By delivering the combined power of our distinctive investment management capabilities, we provide a wide range of investment strategies and vehicles to our clients around the world. If you're looking for challenging work, intelligent colleagues, and exposure across a global footprint, come explore your potential at Invesco.
  
  
**What's in it for you?**
As an organization we support personal needs, diverse backgrounds and provide internal networks, as well as opportunities to get involved in the community and in the world.
  
  
Our benefit policy includes but not limited to:
  

* Competitive Compensation

**Job Description**
**Who We Are**
With over $2.47 trillion of assets under management, Invesco is one of the world’s leading global investment management firms, headquartered in Atlanta, GA. Spreading across 20 countries and with over 8500 dedicated employees, we are driven by trust and care. As one of the world’s leading asset managers, we are solely dedicated to delivering an investment experience that helps people get more out of life. If you're looking for challenging work, thoughtful colleagues, and a global employer with social values, explore your potential at Invesco.
  
  
**Your Team**
The Portfolio Analytics team produces, interprets, and delivers performance attribution and portfolio analytics across Invesco’s global product range. The team supports investment evaluation, business decision-making, client reporting, and continuous improvement through four strategic pillars:
  

* Investment Support: Deliver high-quality, timely, and consistent analysis to Investment teams across all regions and products, enabling performance evaluation and optimization.
* Business Enablement: Provide strategic support to teams driving growth and expansion across Invesco’s global distribution channels.
* Scalable Capability: Enhance operational efficiency by streamlining processes and upgrading technology and infrastructure across regions and functions.
* Talent & Culture: Foster a collaborative environment that supports personal growth, career development, and cross-functional teamwork.

**Your Role**
As a key member of the Portfolio Analytics team, you will produce and interpret portfolio analytics and performance attribution across multiple asset classes and regions. You will acquire, validate, and consolidate portfolio, benchmark, and analytical data; investigate data and reporting exceptions; and communicate findings clearly to investment teams and other stakeholders. Success in this role requires analytical judgment, attention to detail, effective stakeholder communication, and the ability to manage competing priorities in a global environment.
  
  
**The Experience You Bring**

* Working knowledge of portfolio analytics with a focus on performance evaluation assessment across diverse asset classes.
* Ability to interpret portfolio performance, including return attribution, and benchmark comparisons, delivering actionable insights to Investment teams.
* Experienced in extracting, validating, and managing portfolio data to produce accurate and timely reports for internal stakeholders and clients, while effectively addressing data and reporting issues.

Exposure to using performance and risk analytics tools to monitor portfolio risk exposures, conduct stress testing, and perform scenario analysis.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Produce and interpret performance attribution, contribution, benchmark, and portfolio analytics.
* Validate portfolio, benchmark, classification, and analytical data before reporting.
* Investigate and resolve performance, attribution, benchmark, and data-quality exceptions.
* Prepare accurate, timely reporting for investment teams, senior management, client reporting, third-party databases, and regulatory filings.
* Explain analytical results and data issues clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Support process improvement, automation, control enhancement, and documentation.
* Partner with investment, technology, data, operations, risk, and distribution teams across regions.
* Maintain clear process documentation, analytical controls, and evidence supporting reported results.
* Participate in the testing and implementation of data, system, methodology, and reporting changes.

**Work Experience / Knowledge**

* 1–3 years of relevant experience in investment management, portfolio analytics, performance measurement, investment operations, financial data analysis, or a related field.
* Knowledge of performance measurement or Attribution is preferred.
* Prepare, interpret, and investigate discrepancies in attribution and contribution reports used for performance analysis.
* General understanding of the investment management industry including various security types.
* Interpersonal skills necessary to interact effectively with colleagues across functions, regions, and levels are required.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and the ability to work effectively with large and complex data sets
* Preferred: Knowledge of investment analytics/attribution applications (such as FactSet, Aladdin, Bloomberg, etc.)

**Skills & Attributes**

* A friendly professional demeanor and ability to excel in a team-oriented environment.
* Self-driven and shows strong self-initiative to meet deliverables and overcome issues.
* Critical Thinking - ability to look at data and trends and come to new conclusions based on findings.
* Attention to detail – ensure vigilance in the analysis and arrive at right conclusions.
* Must have the ability to handle multiple tasks, prioritize work, meet deadlines, and concentrate on detailed information.

The ability to contribute to a team environment is critical.
  
  
**Academic Requirements**

* Degree in Finance, Accounting, Mathematics, or a related field.

Progress toward, or completion of, the CFA or CIPM designation is preferred
  
  
**Full Time / Part Time**
Full time
  
  
**Worker Type**
Employee

No
  
  
**Workplace Model**
At Invesco, our workplace model supports our culture and meets the needs of our clients while providing flexibility our employees value. As a full-time employee, compliance with the workplace policy means working with your direct manager to create a schedule where you will work in your designated office at least four days a week, with one day working outside an Invesco office.

Build the skills and experiences that help you thrive in a constantly evolving business environment. Our AI-enabled learning platform provides personalized learning opportunities based on your role and interests, while development programs and leadership training help support continuous career growth.

title: Senior Specialist General Ledger
description:
**Context & Purpose:**
JLL Business Services (JBS) operates in a matrixed global environment supporting multiple clusters across AMER, APAC & EMEA regions. Employees are expected to combine operational excellence during close cycles with strong analytical capabilities, stakeholder partnership, process governance, automation adoption and continuous improvement. The organization values ownership, transparency, collaboration, controllership mindset, problem solving and leadership at all levels.
  
  
**Duties and Responsibilities:**
The focus of the role will be upon -
  
  
Completes assigned close tasks to the close calendar and checklist; confirms task completion in the tracker; flags risks to deadlines to the reviewer before the due date; supports cut-off and accrual data collection.
  
  
Fully accountable to the GL month end close (MEC) including Balance Sheet reconciliation preparation
  
  
Act as a strategic bridge between Business and executive leadership. Align departmental priorities with company-wide growth targets, analyze performance data, and advise leaders on operational improvements.
  
  
**What the job involves:**
This document defines the P1 Analyst role within the R2R function, which delivers Month-End Close (MEC), Reconciliations, Financial Reporting, Governance and Continuous Improvement for global accounting operations.
  
  
Detailed job responsibilities are mentioned in below table:
  
  
***Key Responsibilities:***
**Area**
**Responsibilities At This Level**
**Month-End Close (MEC)**
Completes assigned close tasks to the close calendar and checklist; confirms task completion in the tracker; flags risks to deadlines to the reviewer before the due date; supports cut-off and accrual data collection.
  
  
**Journal Entry Management**
Prepares standard recurring and template-based journals with complete supporting documentation; posts only after review or approval as per the delegation matrix; corrects errors under guidance.
  
  
**Balance Sheet Reconciliations**
Prepares reconciliations for assigned low-to-medium risk accounts in Account Reconciliation Cloud Services (ARCS) using standard templates; explains simple variances; submits for review by the deadline.
  
  
**Open Item Management**
Maintains the open item listing for assigned accounts; follows up with the owner for clearance; reports aged items and clearance progress to the reviewer.
  
  
**Financial Reporting**
Compiles standard schedules, trial balance extracts and recurring reports from templates; performs completeness and accuracy checks; supports statutory and management reporting packs.
  
  
**Variance Analysis**
Performs basic month-on-month and actual-versus-budget comparisons using prepared templates; highlights movements above threshold; obtains explanations from the reviewer or business.
  
  
**Governance & Controls**
Executes control steps exactly as documented; retains evidence in the agreed repository; complies with segregation of duties, policies and the code of conduct; reports control breaches immediately.
  
  
**Audit Support**
Retrieves and organises documents and data requested for internal and external audits; responds to simple queries on own work with supervisor guidance.
  
  
**Stakeholder Management**
Responds to routine queries from the team and defined contacts within agreed turnaround times; escalates non-standard requests; maintains professional, courteous communication.
  
  
**Continuous Improvement**
Documents observed errors, delays and rework; suggests simple improvements in team forums; follows updated procedures and keeps desk instructions current.
  
  
**Digital & Automation Adoption**
Uses Account Reconciliation Cloud Services (ARCS), ERP and Excel features as trained; adopts automated workflows and bots in the process; reports tool defects and suggests automation candidates.
  
  

***Required Technical Skills:***
**Skill**
**Expected capability**
**General Accounting**
Understands double-entry bookkeeping, the chart of accounts, accruals, prepayments and the full ledger cycle; applies basic accounting concepts to daily tasks.
  
  
**IFRS / US GAAP**
Awareness of the core principles and the differences relevant to assigned accounts; applies company policy as documented.
  
  
**MEC Management**
Understands the close calendar, task dependencies and cut-off rules for assigned activities.
  
  
**Balance Sheet Reconciliations**
Understands the purpose, types and risk ratings of reconciliations; prepares standard reconciliations using templates.
  
  
**Financial Reporting**
Understands the basics of trial balance, balance sheet and P&L structure and how journals flow to reports.
  
  
**Variance Analysis**
Calculates variances and flags those above threshold; understands common drivers of movement.
  
  
**Journal Review**
Self-reviews own journals for accuracy, support and period; understands the approval hierarchy.
  
  
**Internal Controls**
Understands control objectives, segregation of duties and evidence requirements; follows SOX or equivalent controls as documented.
  
  
**SAP / Oracle / ERP Systems**
Navigates core transactions, line-item reports and master data views for assigned processes.
  
  
**Excel (Advanced)**
Proficient with lookup functions, pivot tables, filters and basic formulas; builds no complex models at this level.
  
  
**Power BI**
Reads and filters dashboards; awareness of how reports are refreshed.
  
  
**Data Analytics**
Performs basic data validation, sorting and trend checks; recognises anomalies and duplicates.
  
  
***Behavioural Competency:***
**Competency**
**Observable expectation**
**Learning Agility**
Absorbs training quickly, applies feedback and asks questions; progresses against the development plan.
  
  
**Adaptability**
Adjusts to changing priorities and close-cycle pressure; works effectively across shifts and time zones when required.
  
  
**Collaboration**
Shares information, supports teammates and contributes to a positive team environment.
  
  
**Customer Orientation**
Responds to requests courteously and within agreed timelines; understands who the internal customers are.
  
  
**Accountability**
Owns assigned tasks to completion; admits and corrects mistakes promptly; meets deadlines.
  
  
**Decision Making**
Makes decisions within defined procedures; recognises the limits of own authority and escalates beyond them.
  
  
**Continuous Improvement Mindset**
Questions manual steps, reports inefficiencies and welcomes process change.
  
  
***Communication Skills:***
**Competency**
**Observable expectation**
**Executive communication**
Not expected to engage executives; writes concise, factual status updates for the supervisor.
  
  
**Presentation Skills**
Walks through own work with the reviewer; contributes to team meetings.
  
  
**Storytelling with financial data**
Summarises what a number shows in one or two clear sentences.
  
  
**Ability to challenge constructively**
Asks clarifying questions politely when instructions or data appear inconsistent.
  
  
**Global stakeholder engagement**
Communicates clearly in English in writing and on calls; shows cultural awareness across all JLL clusters & regions.
  
  
***To apply you need:***
**Item**
**Requirement**
**Education**
Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, Commerce or a related discipline.
  
  
**Certifications**
Not mandatory. Enrolment in or part-completion of CA, CPA, ACCA or CMA is preferred; Account Reconciliation Cloud Services (ARCS) user certification and Excel training are an advantage.
  
  
**Years Of Experience**
5 years in accounting, finance operations or shared services; graduates and career starters welcome.
  
  
**Systems exposure**
Basic exposure to an ERP system (SAP or Oracle) and Excel; Account Reconciliation Cloud Services (ARCS) exposure preferred.
  
  
**Language**
Fluent business English; additional regional languages are an advantage.

title: Intern, Asset Management & Project Coordinator
description:
Intern, Asset Management & Project Coordinator

**Department:**
Asset Management & Project Management Office (PMO)

0–1 Years

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Client:**
US-Based Real Estate Investment Company

**Work Location:**
KPHB, Hyderabad

**Shift:**
5 PM - 2 AM

About the Role

We are looking for a detail-oriented and organized professional to support a US-based real estate investment client across asset management, property operations, financial reporting, lease administration, and project coordination.

The role involves monitoring property performance, coordinating with tenants and vendors, maintaining financial and operational records, tracking projects and payments, and ensuring deadlines and reporting requirements are met. The candidate will work closely with the US team and coordinate across finance, sales, and operations.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Asset Management & Financial Reporting**

* Track property performance, including occupancy, rent rolls, Net Operating Income (NOI), and cash flow against budgets.
* Assist with annual operating budgets, capital expenditure plans, and monthly financial reviews.
* Prepare financial reports, variance analysis, investor reports, and distribution schedules.
* Track capital calls, investor distributions, loan covenants, and lender reporting requirements.
* Support financial analysis, acquisitions, dispositions, and due diligence activities.

**2. Property Operations & Lease Administration**

* Maintain lease records, rent schedules, escalations, renewal dates, and lease expiry details.
* Coordinate lease renewals, new leasing activities, and follow-ups with US brokers.
* Track tenant rent collections, outstanding payments, and accounts receivable.
* Assist with CAM/NNN reconciliations and tenant billbacks.
* Coordinate vendor contracts, service agreements, invoices, and payment approvals.
* Track property insurance renewals, property tax deadlines, and tenant insurance certificates.
* Coordinate with property managers on maintenance requests and inspections.
* Maintain property records, compliance calendars, and monthly operations reports.

**3. Project Coordination & PMO Support**

* Coordinate with US sales, finance, and operations teams on deal pipelines, closings, and operational handovers.
* Maintain project plans, timelines, task trackers, and payment records.
* Track vendor invoice payments, approvals, insurance renewals, and related documentation.
* Schedule meetings, prepare minutes, and follow up on action items and deadlines.
* Prepare weekly status reports, dashboards, and project updates.
* Maintain contracts, project documents, and shared drives.
* Identify and escalate potential risks, delays, and pending dependencies.

Requirements

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Commerce, Business Administration, or any related discipline.
* 0–1 years of experience in finance, accounting, real estate, property management, lease administration, or project coordination.
* Freshers with strong fundamentals and a willingness to learn are welcome.
* Good knowledge of MS Excel, including formulas, pivot tables, and lookups.
* Working knowledge of MS Word, PowerPoint, or Google Workspace.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
* Good organizational and documentation skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.
* Comfortable coordinating with US-based teams, tenants, vendors, and other stakeholders during US business hours.

Good to Have

* Knowledge of US commercial real estate concepts such as NOI, cap rates, CAM, NNN leases, DSCR, and lease structures.
* Familiarity with financial modelling, investor reporting, or real estate investment processes.
* Exposure to tools such as Yardi, AppFolio, MRI, Argus, or VTS.
* Experience with project management tools such as Asana, Monday.com, Smartsheet, MS Project, or Zoho.
* MBA, CA/CA Inter, CFA, CAPM, or similar qualifications/certifications.

You are a strategic thinker passionate about driving solutions in Treasury. You have found the right team.
  
  
As a Liquidity Associate in our Finance team, you will spend each day defining, refining and delivering set goals for our firm. You will be instrumental in managing the liquidity, balance sheet, and capital positions of our Investment Banking businesses. In this role, you will engage with a variety of stakeholders, including senior leadership and global teams, to develop and implement strategies that enhance our risk management capabilities. This position offers a dynamic and fast-paced environment, ideal for individuals with a keen interest in capital markets and economics.

* Develop and deliver detailed liquidity metrics packages for CIB senior management and key stakeholders, ensuring all reports are accurate and timely.
* Leverage understanding of financial products such as deposits, commitments, derivatives, and secured funding, along with regulatory guidelines like Basel III and LCR/NSFR, to assess their potential impact on our Line of Business.

* Collaborate with FALMA, CTMO, and other stakeholders to ensure the timely and accurate production of regulatory reporting, maintaining a high standard of data integrity.
* Engage with senior CIB Treasury and business leadership, Controllers, Global Treasury, and Liquidity Risk Oversight to gather, understand, and analyze information related to balance sheet and liquidity implications.
* Contribute to ongoing process improvements, optimization, and rationalization efforts related to balance sheet and liquidity management, driving efficiency and effectiveness in operations.

* Bachelor's Degree in Finance or a related field, with a minimum of 4 years of experience in finance, emphasizing analytical work.
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to think creatively and solve complex problems. You should be comfortable managing large datasets and extracting meaningful insights.
* A solid understanding of finance and financial markets, including On and Off balance sheet products, particularly those related to market business such as prime brokerage and secured funding.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to present information in a clear, concise, and effective manner.
* Strong organizational skills, with the ability to execute responsibilities independently, take ownership of tasks, and work under pressure to prioritize and complete multiple tasks.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Access.

* Experience with automation tools such as Alteryx, Tableau, or Python, which can enhance data analysis and reporting capabilities.

* Contribute to ongoing process improvements, optimization, and rationalization efforts related to balance sheet and liquidity management, driving efficiency and effectiveness in operations.

WPP is on a global transformation journey, and this is an opportunity to join support the treasury activities for operating companies in India.
  
  
**What you'll be doing:**
The role report to Regional Treasurer and responsible for overseeing India’s cashflow & liquidity, investments, banking relationships, foreign exchange risk to support business growth and financial stability.
  
  
This role will report into the Asia Pacific Treasurer, key responsibilities are:
  
  
***Liquidity & Working Capital Management***

* Monitor daily cash position and manage liquidity planning to ensure adequate funding for business operations in India.
* Prepare and maintain short-term and long-term cash flow forecasts (e.g., weekly, monthly, quarterly) to minimize idle excess cash.
* Optimize working capital and manage the deployment of surplus funds in deposit placement for yield enhancement.
* Lead and oversee the service fee settlement and dividend repatriation in timely manner.

***Banking & Financial Institution Management***

* Serve as the primary point of contact for banking partners in India; negotiate terms, pricing, and facilities. Bringing their advice and expertise to bear as required for risk management or other purposes.
* Manage banking documentation, KYC, and regulatory compliance.

***Forex Exposure & Investment Management***

* Identify, manage, and report on foreign exchange (FX) exposure across the networks.
* Design and implement foreign currency hedging strategies for business operation as to mitigate their financial risks.
* Advise the business on FEMA (Foreign Exchange Management Act) compliance and requirements.

***Business partnering***

* Build deep relationship with CFOs and FDs across diverse networks and influence decisions on working capital and foreign exchange management.
* Support the communications of treasury policy and internal control standards, ensure it is applied in compliance with the related local treasury procedures.
* Monitor and assess the impact of local market conditions such as regulation, currency controls, financial products and advise on this internally.
* Support Treasury GBS team as required on joint or Treasury led developments.

**Intercompany Funding & Debt Management**

* Support fund-raising activities through various instruments like bank loans, intercompany financing.
* Manage the loan drawdown and repayment of operating entities in India, including refinancing and ensuring timely servicing of debt obligations.

**Candidate Qualifications & Experience**

* Educational Background:
* Experience graduate / postgraduate
* Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA), A CTP (Certified Treasury Professional) qualification is a strong plus.

***Professional Experience:***

* 11-15 years of progressive experience in corporate treasury, cash management, or a similar finance role.
* Proven experience with Treasury Management Systems (e.g., IT/2) is highly desirable.
* Deep understanding of RBI regulations, FEMA, and local banking practices.
* Strong experience in managing banking relationships and forex hedging instruments.
* Knowledge of derivatives and hedging currency exposures directly or indirectly.
* Knowledge of accounting in relation to FX gains and losses and where they arise.

**Key Skills**

* Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Profound understanding and operation experiences in cash management and FX risk management products
* Experience operating in a multi-currency, multi-entity global organization is a plus.
* Experience in Power BI a plus

title: Accounts Payable & Receivable Executive -Andheri East
description:
Role Summary
  
  
We are looking for a detail-oriented Accounts Payable & Receivable Executive to manage the day-to-day finance operations of the company. You will own the end-to-end payables and receivables cycle, from vendor invoice processing and payments to customer billing and collections, while ensuring accuracy, statutory compliance and timely reporting.
  
  
Key ResponsibilitiesAccounts Payable
  
  

* Verify, code and process vendor invoices with proper three-way matching (PO, GRN, invoice).
* Prepare and execute vendor payments on schedule via NEFT/RTGS/UPI and other banking channels, after required approvals.
* Maintain vendor master data, including bank details, GST and PAN, and ensure KYC and documentation are complete.
* Reconcile vendor statements with the books and resolve discrepancies or disputes promptly.
* Track payment due dates, manage the payment calendar and avoid late payment penalties.
* Ensure correct TDS deduction, GST input credit eligibility and timely deposit of statutory dues.
* Process employee expense claims and petty cash, where applicable.

Accounts Receivable
  
  

* Prepare and issue customer invoices, credit notes and debit notes accurately and on time.
* Monitor outstanding receivables, maintain ageing reports and follow up with customers for timely collections.
* Perform cash application: match receipts to invoices and update the ledgers.
* Coordinate with sales and operations teams to resolve billing queries and disputes.
* Escalate overdue and doubtful accounts to management with recommended actions.
* Reconcile customer ledgers and share account statements and balance confirmations.

Operations & Monitoring
  
  

* Post daily accounting entries in the ERP/accounting software (Tally, Zoho Books, SAP or similar).
* Perform bank reconciliations (daily/weekly/monthly) and clear reconciling items.
* Monitor cash flow, payment schedules and receivable inflows; provide regular cash position updates.
* Prepare MIS reports: payables ageing, receivables ageing, vendor outstanding, DSO and collection summaries.
* Support month-end and year-end closing, including provisions, accruals and ledger scrutiny.
* Assist with GST, TDS and other statutory filings and coordinate with external CAs and auditors.
* Support internal and statutory audits by providing documents and clarifications.
* Improve and document AP/AR processes and internal controls.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* B.Com / M.Com or equivalent; CA Inter, MBA (Finance) or similar is a plus.
* 4–15 years of experience in accounts payable, accounts receivable or general accounting.
* Working knowledge of GST, TDS and basic Indian accounting and taxation norms.
* Proficiency in Tally / Zoho Books / SAP or similar accounting software.
* Strong Excel skills (VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, pivot tables, reconciliations).
* Good understanding of banking operations and online payment processes.
* Strong attention to detail, with good analytical and numerical ability.
* Clear communication skills for dealing with vendors, customers and internal teams.
* Ability to manage deadlines and work with minimal supervision.

**Preferred Attributes**

* Experience handling a high volume of vendor payments and collections.
* Exposure to ERP systems and automation of finance workflows.
* High integrity and discretion in handling confidential financial information.
* Proactive, ownership-driven approach to problem solving.

Key Performance Indicators
  
  

* Timeliness and accuracy of vendor payments
* Reduction in overdue receivables and DSO
* Accuracy of reconciliations and month-end closing timelines
* Zero statutory penalties or late filings
* Quality and timeliness of MIS reporting

* Background conducting independent review and challenge, regulatory examinations, internal audit reviews or second-line risk oversight.
* Experience managing governance, controls, issue tracking and regulatory engagement processes.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills combined with proven project and stakeholder management capabilities across a global organization.

As sustainability reporting requirements continue to evolve, the team is focused on strengthening controls, improving data quality, increasing reporting efficiency, and building scalable processes that support future business needs.
  
  
This role sits within the Greenhouse Gas (GHG) Reporting pillar of GCSC. The pillar is responsible for the development, governance, reporting, and continuous improvement of the firm's operational GHG inventory and associated reporting processes. The team plays an important role in delivering trusted emissions data, supporting assurance activities, and helping the firm monitor progress against its operational sustainability objectives.
  
  
**Your Role and Impact**
The Sustainability Data, Process & Reporting Associate will play a key role in both the delivery and modernization of the firm's operational GHG reporting processes. This role combines participation in GHG inventory reporting, controls, and assurance activities with dedicated responsibility for identifying, designing, and implementing process improvements. The successful candidate will help improve how sustainability data is collected, managed, validated, and reported while supporting the team's efforts to enhance reporting efficiency, scalability, timeliness, and data quality.
  
  
The role provides a unique opportunity to apply data analysis, process optimization, automation, and technology-enabled problem solving within a rapidly evolving sustainability reporting environment. Working closely with business and technology stakeholders, the individual will help challenge existing ways of working, identify opportunities for improvement, and support the development of more efficient and scalable reporting capabilities.
  
  
**Your Responsibilities**

* Support the collection, validation, reconciliation, and consolidation of data used in the operational GHG inventory and related sustainability reporting activities.
* Support reporting, controls, documentation, audit readiness, and assurance activities to help ensure the accuracy, completeness, and reliability of reported information.
* Develop a detailed understanding of existing sustainability reporting processes, data flows, systems, operational dependencies, and control frameworks.
* Identify opportunities to improve reporting efficiency, strengthen controls, re
* duce manual effort, and enhance data quality through data-driven process improvements.
* Design, develop, and implement automation opportunities, workflow enhancements, and scalable reporting solutions that improve operational effectiveness and reporting timeliness.
* Partner with stakeholders across sustainability, enterprise services, finance, data, and technology teams to deliver reporting improvements and support implementation of enhanced processes and tools.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and artificial intelligence-enabled capabilities that can enhance sustainability reporting, management information, operational decision-making, and process efficiency.

**Your Experience**

* Experience working within reporting, controls, or assurance environments, with a strong understanding of reporting processes, reconciliations, governance frameworks, and the production of reliable management or external reporting.
* Experience working with complex datasets and proven ability to identify inefficiencies and implement process improvements through automation, workflow redesign, technology-enabled solutions, or continuous improvement initiatives.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with the ability to translate business requirements into practical and scalable solutions.
* Sustainability reporting, GHG accounting, environmental reporting, or environmental data management experience.
* Experience partnering effectively with stakeholders across business, operations, and technology teams to deliver improvements and solve complex business challenges.
* Demonstrated interest in emerging technologies, automation, and artificial intelligence-enabled solutions, with a focus on improving business processes, reporting capabilities, and operational efficiency.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across business and technical teams.

**Yours Skills And Qualifications**

* Bachelor or Masters degree.
* 3-5 years relevant work experience (ideally Financial Services).
* Experience working with PowerBI, SQL, AI models or comparable data management and automation tools.

**What Will Help You Excel**

* A natural curiosity for how processes work and how they can be improved.
* A passion for using data to solve business problems and drive better outcomes.
* A proactive mindset with the confidence to challenge existing ways of working and propose new approaches.
* The ability to balance delivery of operational responsibilities with longer-term improvement initiatives.
* Interest in sustainability, environmental reporting, and the evolving role of technology within reporting and controls functions.

**Why Join Us**

* This role offers a unique opportunity to help shape the future of sustainability reporting within a growing and evolving function. You will contribute to critical GHG reporting activities while helping drive improvements in data quality, reporting efficiency, automation, controls, and process design.
* You will work at the intersection of sustainability, data, process improvement, and technology, helping build more scalable and timely reporting capabilities that support the firm's operational sustainability objectives and evolving reporting requirements.

**Our Benefits**
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
  
  
**Our hybrid work model**
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
  
  
**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided

on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
  
  
**About BlackRock**
At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
  
  
This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
  
  
To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.

description:

Working with our clients across real estate, infrastructure, energy and natural resources, we transform together delivering outcomes that improve people’s lives. Working in partnership makes it possible to deliver the world’s most impactful projects and programmes as we turn challenge into opportunity and complexity into success.
  
  
Our capabilities include programme, project, cost, asset and commercial management, controls and performance, procurement and supply chain, net zero and digital solutions.
  
  
We are majority-owned by CBRE Group, Inc., the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, with our partners holding a significant minority interest. Drive commercial excellence across large-scale Asia projects in
**infrastructure, energy, and natural resources**
, ensuring robust contract strategy, disciplined cost control, and proactive risk management. You will lead negotiations for complex construction agreements, manage claims and disputes, and establish governance frameworks that protect margins and enable successful delivery of multi-billion-dollar projects.

**Strategic Imperative**

Transform commercial and contractual rigor into a strategic advantage: standardize contract playbooks, enforce risk allocation discipline (FIDIC/NEC/local forms), lead high-value negotiations, and institutionalize lessons learned to strengthen delivery certainty and profitability across diverse Asia markets.

**Key Responsibilities**

**2) Contracting & Negotiations**

* Drive value engineering initiatives and monitor commitments against approved budgets.

**4) Risk & Compliance**

* Identify and mitigate commercial, legal, and execution risks across multi-jurisdictional projects.
* Apply international and regional contract standards (FIDIC, NEC, local forms) and ensure compliance with regulatory frameworks.
* Conduct post-project reviews to capture lessons learned and improve future contracting strategies.

**5) Claims & Dispute Management**

* Manage dispute avoidance and resolution boards (DAB/DRB) and negotiate settlement agreements where necessary.

**6) Stakeholder & Partner Engagement**

* Act as the senior commercial representative with clients, contractors, lenders, and government authorities.

**7) Leadership & Team Development**

* Mentor and develop Commercial Managers and Analysts; foster a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.

Promote collaboration across Project Delivery, Engineering, Legal, and Finance teams

**Qualifications**

**Essential**

* 10–15+ years’ experience in commercial management for major infrastructure, energy, or natural resource projects.
* Degree in Quantity Surveying, Construction Management, Engineering, Finance, or related discipline.
* Proven track record in negotiating multi-million-dollar EPC and O&M contracts for large-scale projects.
* Expertise in claims management and dispute resolution for projects exceeding $500M.
* Strong knowledge of FIDIC/NEC and regional contract forms; ability to tailor risk allocation by jurisdiction.
* Advanced negotiation, financial analysis, and stakeholder management skills.

**Preferred**

* Professional certifications (MRICS, AIQS, PMP or equivalent).
* Experience in renewable energy, power generation, or heavy engineering sectors.
* Familiarity with cultural and regulatory nuances across APAC markets.

**Core Competencies**

* **Commercial Acumen:**
  Understands full P&L impact and risk exposure.

title: Data Analytics Associate
description:
**Job Description**
You are a strategic thinker passionate about driving solutions in
**Financial Analytics, Reporting, Business Intelligence, Data Science (EDA and Modelling) and AI / Gen AI**
. You have found the right team.
  
  
As a Financial Analytics Associate within our Asset and Wealth Management Transformation and Analytics Team, you will define, refine, and deliver strategic goals for our firm by translating complex financial and operational data into actionable insights, predictive models, and AI-promoten solutions that enhance decision-making and promote business performance.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Scope, prioritize and co-ordinate activities with product owners and finance stakeholders. Partner with Finance, Risk and Business teams to identify strategic analytical, data science and AI solutions. Perform in-depth financial analysis including revenue, expense, margin, variance, profitability, product/client profitability and KPI analysis to support business decisions.
* Design, develop and automate management reporting, dashboards and scorecards covering P&L, balance sheet, cash flow, forecasts, budgets, headcount and performance metrics. Drive the annual budgeting, mid-year re-forecast, rolling forecast and multi-year strategic planning cycles in partnership with Business Finance teams.
* Implement exploratory data analysis (EDA) and statistical modelling to identify trends, patterns and drivers of financial performance. Identify key financial and operational data sources that can drive business impact; ensure data quality, reconciliation and audit trails across reporting outputs.
* Design and develop data mining and reporting queries from large data sets (both structured and unstructured) and convert raw financial data into clear information. Build compelling visualizations and storytelling using BI tools (Tableau, Power BI, Alteryx) that translate financial results and model outputs into clear business narratives for senior leadership.
* Employ scaling and automation to data preparation, consolidation and reporting workflows to improve efficiency and accuracy of recurring financial deliverables. Transform model outputs and analytical results into formats digestible to end users through visualizations, clear tables and thoughtful presentations; assist technical and non-technical stakeholders in interpreting the analysis.
* Leverage AI assistants and copilots (e.g., Microsoft 365 Copilot, GitHub Copilot, and in-house Gen AI tooling) to accelerate analytics workflows — code generation, SQL/Python drafting, document summarization, and natural-language querying of financial datasets — while applying firm-approved controls on data confidentiality and model output review.

**Required Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills**

* Self-starter, attention to detail and results oriented, able to work under minimal guidance in a fast-paced environment.
* Uses pertinent financial data and facts to identify and solve a range of business problems within area of expertise.
* Mandatory experience in financial analytics, FP&A, management reporting, variance analysis and KPI/performance measurement. Strong understanding of accounting principles (US GAAP / IFRS), financial statements (P&L, balance sheet, cash flow), journal entries, intercompany, allocations, accruals and month-end close processes.
* Working knowledge of profitability and performance metrics: unit economics, gross/operating margin, contribution margin, EBITDA, ROE/ROA, cost-to-income ratio, NIM, fee revenue and AUM-based metrics.
* Mandatory experience in Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA), regression and statistical/machine learning modelling applied to financial or business datasets. Hands-on experience with pandas and PySpark/PySQL stack. Experience in building data extraction, transformation and modelling pipelines.
* Strong proficiency in SQL (Snowflake, Databricks) and Python (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, Keras, PySpark/PySQL) for data wrangling, modelling, AI pipelines and automation of financial workflows. Hands-on experience using AI skills / copilots to support analytics work — e.g., Microsoft 365 Copilot (Excel, Power BI, Word, PowerPoint), GitHub Copilot, for SQL generation, data summarization and productivity gains in day-to-day financial analytics deliverables; awareness of responsible-AI, data-privacy and model-risk guardrails.
* Working proficiency in data visualization tools; strong experience with BI technologies including but not limited to Tableau, Power BI and Alteryx. Experience in end-to-end implementation of Business Intelligence (BI) reports and dashboards for finance, risk or business performance reporting. Should be good at mathematics, inferential statistics and quantitative analysis as applied to financial data and model building.
* Provides explanations and information to others on topics within area of expertise; strong business partnering skills with Finance and Business stakeholders.
* Experience Required: 5+ years in data/analytics related projects with 2+ years in financial analytics
* Good communication and analytical skills, with the ability to present financial insights, model results and AI-driven outputs clearly to senior stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills**

* Bachelor's Degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Statistics, Data Science, Computer Science or Engineering. A different field of study with significant professional experience in Financial Analytics / BI / Data Science / AI is acceptable. MBA (Finance) is a strong plus.
* Exposure to Asset & Wealth Management / banking products and metrics (AUM, net flows, revenue yield, client profitability, fee waivers) is strongly preferred.

**ABOUT US**
JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.
  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.
  
  
**About The Team**
J.P. Morgan Asset & Wealth Management delivers industry-leading investment management and private banking solutions. Asset Management provides individuals, advisors and institutions with strategies and expertise that span the full spectrum of asset classes through our global network of investment professionals. Wealth Management helps individuals, families and foundations take a more intentional approach to their wealth or finances to better define, focus and realize their goals.

* Partner with Technology teams to define and test system enhancements.
* Assist with regulatory change implementation and process documentation updates.

* Collaborate with Legal, Compliance, Operations, Technology, Risk, and Business teams on reporting requirements and issue resolution.
* Participate in governance forums and reporting oversight meetings.
* Communicate reporting status, key risks, and remediation progress to stakeholders.
* Support regulatory change management efforts and business readiness activities.

**Documentation & Governance**

* Maintain process documentation, operating procedures, and control inventories.
* Support management information (MI), KPIs, KRIs, and governance reporting.
* Ensure procedures remain aligned with regulatory requirements and operational practices.
* Contribute to governance, audit readiness, and control documentation activities.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, Information Systems, or a related field.
* 2-5 years of experience in Regulatory Reporting, Operations, Compliance, Risk Management, Financial Services, or a related function.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent attention to detail and control-oriented mindset.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and other MS Office applications.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Knowledge of regulatory reporting regimes such as EMIR, UK EMIR, MiFIR, SFTR, CFTC, ASIC, MAS, or similar frameworks.
* Experience with trade lifecycle processes and transaction reporting.
* Familiarity with SQL, Python, Alteryx, Power BI, or data analytics tools.
* Experience working with control frameworks, reconciliations, and data quality processes.
* Understanding of regulatory governance and compliance requirements.

**Core Competencies**

* Regulatory and Compliance Awareness
* Risk & Control Mindset
* Analytical Thinking
* Problem Solving
* Stakeholder Management
* Process Improvement & Automation
* Effective Communication
* Accountability & Ownership
* Collaboration & Teamwork
* Adaptability and Continuous Learning

**Success Measures**

* Timely and accurate regulatory submissions.
* Reduction in reporting exceptions and control breaches.
* Effective issue investigation and remediation.
* Strong audit and compliance outcomes.
* Successful delivery of process improvement and automation initiatives.
* High-quality stakeholder engagement and governance reporting.

**Our Benefits**
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
  
  
**Our hybrid work model**
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
  
  
**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
**guidance**
on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
  
  
**About BlackRock**
At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
  
  
This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
  
  
To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
  
  
BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

You will empower our Operations teams to gain a comprehensive understanding of their processes, identify friction points, mitigate risks, and enhance client service. While strong BI skills are essential, success in this role hinges on a deep, proactive engagement with business processes. We are looking for an individual who is driven to ask critical questions, challenge existing methods, and relentlessly pursue inefficiencies, rather than passively waiting for problems to be presented.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Strategic Partnership: Collaborate closely with Market Operations management and technology partners to define and execute the analytics agenda, prioritizing high-value use cases that align with strategic objectives.
* Proactive Problem Identification & Analysis: Beyond assessing known bottlenecks, you will proactively deep-dive into operational processes, using data and insightful questioning (e.g., "why is this done this way?", "what is the purpose of this step?") to identify underlying challenges and systemic inefficiencies. Leverage data to substantiate and support evaluations and recommendations for process health improvements.
* Data-Driven Hypothesis Testing: Conduct in-depth statistical analysis using business data to prove or disprove hypotheses related to process friction, risk exposure, and client behavior.
* Actionable Insights: Produce detailed analyses of complex issues, recommending clear courses of action even when solutions are not immediately evident, and support their implementation.
* Solution Development: Design, develop, and implement robust data analytics and dashboarding solutions that provide clear, actionable insights into operational performance and efficiency.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Build and maintain strong, effective working relationships with Operations stakeholders at all levels, conducting interviews to deeply understand business functions, pain points, and risks from the user’s perspective.
* Program Management: Contribute to the delivery and management of technical data programs across multiple businesses and geographies.
* Change Leadership: Drive change within a collaborative, agile team environment and adapt to unexpected requirement changes and tight deadlines.

**What You Will Bring:**
**Technical Expertise:**

* Advanced SQL: Strong experience with SQL and relational databases for complex data querying and manipulation.
* BI Visualization: Proven experience creating effective and sophisticated dashboards using major BI visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Qlikview).
* Data Storytelling: Ability to effectively query and join disparate large datasets, perform complex analysis, and translate findings into compelling narratives and actionable solutions.
* ETL/Data Prep (Plus): Experience with ETL solutions such as Alteryx, Tableau Prep, or PowerQuery.
* Programming (Plus): Experience with Python, R, or PySpark for advanced analytics.

**Professional Attributes:**

* Minimum 5-8 years of experience in data science, data analytics role preferably in financial services or capital markets domain
* Proactive Business Acumen & Inquisitiveness: Extremely inquisitive, curious, and possess strong critical thinking skills. A genuine drive to deeply understand underlying business functions, friction points, and risks by asking challenging questions (e.g., "why is this process necessary?", "what value does this step add?"). A natural aversion to inefficiency and a passion for finding logical, streamlined solutions.
* Communication & Influence: Demonstrated interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills, with excellent client servicing and presentation abilities. Able to clearly articulate complex insights and influence stakeholders towards data-driven decisions.
* Collaboration & Leadership: Strong ability to establish, build, and maintain effective working relationships across diverse teams, including the ability to coach and mentor.
* Results-Oriented: Proven ability to work independently as well as part of virtual teams to deliver strategic outcomes, managing tight deadlines and adapting to evolving requirements.

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s/University degree or equivalent experience in a quantitative or technical field such as Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering.

* Experience running reports and exports from Salesforce or another CRM.
* High attention to detail, strong data quality mindset, and the ability to spot inconsistencies or anomalies quickly.
* Good written and verbal communication skills in English; able to explain data and methodology clearly to non‑technical stakeholders.
* Comfortable working with a distributed team and collaborating across time zones.
* Basic SQL query writing experience.
* Exposure to RevOps or GTM processes (leads → opportunities → bookings → renewals).
* Experience automating recurring reports or data refreshes using scripts, connectors, or workflow tools.
